```{r}
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  # Total number of unique combinations possible
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)
  if (n > max_combinations) stop(paste("n exceeds total unique combinations:", max_combinations))
  
  seen <- list()
  result <- list()
  
  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(function(mx) sample(1:mx, size = 1), POSITION_MAX)
    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")
    
    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }
  
  result
}

```


```{r}
source("tapho_loader_new.R")   #c(2,1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2) c( 4 ,4 ,1 ,2 ,3 ,2,2 ,2 ,1 ,1 ,4)
excel_path <- "hspa.xlsx"

system.time({
levels_vec <- random_vectors(n = 1)
for (lvl in levels_vec){
```

```{r}
#| label: bone-level-distribution
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

library(tidyverse)

# Convert list-column into long format
bone_long <- tapho_db %>%
  select(bone.level) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  unnest_longer(
    bone.level,
    values_to = "bone_level",
    indices_to = "position"
  )

# Make position a factor so it is displayed from 1 to 11
bone_long <- bone_long %>%
  mutate(
    position = factor(position, levels = 1:11),
    bone_level = factor(bone_level, levels = 1:5)
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. ALL POSITIONS TOGETHER
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(bone_long, aes(x = bone_level)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Bone Levels Across All Positions",
    x = "Bone level",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```


```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. EACH OF THE 11 POSITIONS SEPARATELY
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(bone_long, aes(x = bone_level)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ position, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Bone Levels by Position",
    subtitle = "Each panel represents one of the 11 vector positions",
    x = "Bone level",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
